summary: Aviat Networks filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 disclosing that its subsidiary, Aviat Networks (India) Ltd., entered an IP license agreement on September 30, 2026 with Dixon Electro Appliances Private Ltd. Dixon receives a limited license to technical know-how to manufacture, use and offer for sale microwave radios, mainly WTM 4000 family products in India, alongside a manufacturing and supply agreement. Aviat retains its intellectual property and continues supplying software and services. No financial terms, ownership stakes, board recommendation, advisors or regulatory clocks were disclosed; this is a routine commercial licensing arrangement, not a special situation.
